modules.module_title: Assist in setting up the hatchery

pcs.pc_description: assist in setting up the required facility and infrastructure for the hatchery including the pre and post-spawning tanks, etc.
assist in setting up and checking the operation of pumps, filters and other equipment
assist in selecting healthy broodstock of the selected species through careful examination
check the origin of the broodstock and their weight to ensure compliance with the established quality standards
quarantine the broodstock as per instructions until their disease/ infection status is ascertained
maintain an adequate number of containers in the quarantine room for effective routine in and out movement of broodstock
maintain separate treatment and disinfection areas, following the recommended practices to prevent the spread of infectious organisms
dispose the infected/ unfit broodstock and wastewater following the supervisor’s instructions/ recommended practices
disinfect the tools and equipment used in the quarantine area regularly
assist in acclimatising the broodstock to the environment in the maturation facility, regulating the temperature as per the supervisor’s instructions
maintain the recommended water, salinity, pH and oxygen levels in the maturation facility
follow the appropriate measures/ supervisor’s instructions to prevent contamination and growth of harmful organisms in the maturation facility

modules.module_title: Assist in maintaining the maturation room and broodstock

pcs.pc_description: maintain appropriate light in the maturation room as per the supervisor’s instructions to support the maturation of broodstock
drain the maturation tanks and clean them periodically as per instructions
maintain minimum noise and movement in the maturation room
maintain the broodstock in the maturation room until their maturation
maintain the required water quality parameters for spawning as per the supervisor’s instructions
disinfect the spawning tank for stocking the gravid female
identify the gravid female broodstock and place it in a container
transfer the gravid female broodstock with spermatophore to the spawning tank
feed the broodstock with a balanced diet containing the recommended quantity of vitamins, minerals, and fatty acids
monitor the spawning rate and process
count the eggs to determine the quantity of egg production and fertilization
collect the eggs to be transferred to the hatching tank
prepare the isolation room and hatching tank
stock the eggs in the hatching tank, maintaining the same temperature as that of spawning tank
aerate the tanks as per instructions to keep the eggs moving
carry out aeration until the appearance of nauplii
harvest the larvae as per instructions
wash and disinfect the harvested larvae through an immersion bath to prevent contamination
discard the weaker larvae and unhatched eggs
select larvae samples for health analysis
assist in screening the larvae on the relevant parameters
maintain the harvested larvae in optimal conditions

modules.module_title: Assist in performing larvae’s feed management

pcs.pc_description: prepare larvae’s feed as per the supervisor’s instructions
follow the recommended practices to protect the feed from contamination during its storage and handling
store the feed in cool, dry and well- ventilated condition
feed the larvae ensuring an appropriate quantity of nutrients
apply changes to the feed according to the stages of larvae’s growth

modules.module_title: Assist in performing larvae’s health management

pcs.pc_description: maintain the water quality parameters as per the instructions to ensure optimum growth of larvae
stock larvae in groups in separate units according to the stages of their growth, maintaining the recommended stocking density
check the health of larvae regularly as per the supervisor’s instructions
maintain the record of health checks, larvae growth, water quality parameters, etc.
carry out the stress test under supervision
identify the signs of disease and infection in the larvae with the supervisor’s help
assist in taking infected/moribund larvae samples if any to be examined in a laboratory to determine the type of infection and disease affecting them
maintain the larvae until they grow to the size of fry

modules.module_title: Prepare the fry for being transported

pcs.pc_description: stock the larvae/post-larvae in appropriate containers/ tanks for being transported
follow the recommended practices to protect the larvae/post-larvae from contamination during their handling and transportation
check that the transport vehicle has the appropriate temperature and hygienic conditions for transporting larvae/post-larvae
optimise the usage of water, electricity and other resources in various tasks and processes
connect the electrical tools and equipment safely and turn them off when not in use
plug/arrest any water leakages to prevent its wastage

modules.module_title: Assist in maintaining hygiene and safety in the hatchery

pcs.pc_description: maintain hygiene and dry the floor in the hatchery to prevent disease/ infections and any accidents
clean and disinfect the tanks, tools and equipment regularly
follow the recommended safety measures while handling different types of chemicals
treat the water with chlorine and filter it before using it in the hatchery

modules.module_title: Carry out repair and maintenance work

pcs.pc_description: check the hatchery regularly to identify any infrastructural repair and maintenance needs
check the water supply and disposal systems to identify their repair and maintenance needs
arrange an alternative water supply with the supervisor’s help before carrying out any repair and maintenance of the water supply system
carry out all repair and maintenance activities as per the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and report complex repair needs to the supervisor
assist the supervisor in maintaining the record of repair and maintenance activities
segregate waste into appropriate categories
assist in treating and recycling wastewater and other types of waste
dispose the non-recyclable waste in an environment-friendly manner
